sciri_exile_council.reference: IRQ_ministry_of_education/IRQ_restructure_school_curriculum (05_iraq.txt): real education law and education-cost/research spirit. 1970 adaptation uses education costs/literacy or bounded categories.
sciri_exile_council.rationale: A formed exile organization brings a trained domestic council, not a 1970 organization before its actual formation.

sciri_iraqi_charter.description: An Iraqi charter should define how a government formed around religious opposition will exercise public authority. Representative offices and dependable contracts can give that settlement substance, while requiring the leadership to share responsibility beyond its own executive circle.
sciri_iraqi_charter.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
sciri_iraqi_charter.rationale: A representative charter creates public contractual capacity, not simply four stability points.

sciri_clerical_executive.description: A clerical executive would give the movement a concentrated center of political and military decision. It promises a clearer direction, but the security establishment needed to sustain that authority will carry costs of its own.
sciri_clerical_executive.reference: IRQ_restore_faith_in_army/IRQ_address_army_corruption (05_iraq.txt): 25 land XP/command power and native institutions. SOV_academy: planning/training institution; scaled native military modifier package.
sciri_clerical_executive.rationale: A clerical executive concentrates political and command authority at an actual security cost.

sciri_representative_cabinet.description: A representative cabinet needs ministers who can collect revenue and administer instruction across Iraq. Building that competence will broaden the movement's governing base, while making it responsible for a public administration larger than its original networks.
sciri_representative_cabinet.reference: IRQ_ministry_of_education/IRQ_restructure_school_curriculum (05_iraq.txt): real education law and education-cost/research spirit. 1970 adaptation uses education costs/literacy or bounded categories.
sciri_representative_cabinet.rationale: A representative cabinet organizes revenue and instruction with a public administration bill.

sciri_revolutionary_courts.description: Courts established under revolutionary authority can become instruments through which the executive secures appointments and enforces its political direction. That choice may strengthen the governing circle, but it also deepens the burden of exceptional policing and the distrust of those subject to it.
sciri_revolutionary_courts.reference: IRQ_cooperation_with_army/IRQ_restructured_police (05_iraq.txt/Iraqi.txt): root-out resistance effectiveness and police-cost reform; country effects are not a geographic security guarantee.
sciri_revolutionary_courts.rationale: Courts used for executive consolidation yield appointment authority at security/legitimacy cost, not a fabricated efficiency or atrocity dividend.

sciri_returnees.description: Returning families and political organizers bring experience that the new administration cannot afford to waste. Their place in public institutions should be defined through useful civilian work, while the government prepares the services needed to support their return.
sciri_returnees.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
sciri_returnees.rationale: Returning civilian experience builds education and services; no population/foreign manpower is created.

sciri_independent_relations.description: A government in Baghdad must answer for its own decisions even where its leaders once relied on Iranian support. More resilient institutions and diversified public contracts can widen its room to act, without pretending that existing obligations have simply disappeared.
sciri_independent_relations.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
sciri_independent_relations.rationale: An independent Iraqi government gains resistance to outside political pressure and diversified project terms.

sciri_patron_compact.description: Closer alignment with a patron can make technical cooperation and political support easier to organize. Iraq must prepare the services needed to use any assistance it receives, while recognizing the influence that dependence can give the government supplying it.
sciri_patron_compact.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
sciri_patron_compact.rationale: Iraqi technical reception and support administration are useful, but political dependence is real. Equipment, Iranian missions and finance still require actual agreement.

sciri_border_agreement.description: Border administration should reduce the uncertainties that allow local incidents to become national crises. Iraq can prepare more regular supplies and public security arrangements, while any lasting agreement with Iran will still require Tehran's acceptance.
sciri_border_agreement.reference: IRQ_cooperation_with_army/IRQ_restructured_police (05_iraq.txt/Iraqi.txt): root-out resistance effectiveness and police-cost reform; country effects are not a geographic security guarantee.
sciri_border_agreement.rationale: Border liaison has an Iraqi administrative/logistics result even before a consensual treaty; no foreign territory or automatic ceasefire.

sciri_aid_terms.description: Assistance offered through personal channels can leave the treasury uncertain about what it owes and what it should receive. Published accounts and clear project terms will make Iraqi reconstruction more dependable, even where a prospective donor chooses not to participate.
sciri_aid_terms.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
sciri_aid_terms.rationale: Published aid accounts improve own project/treasury administration; foreign aid money is still transferred only on acceptance.

sciri_security_state.description: Armed authority cannot remain divided indefinitely between civilian ministries and formations sustained through political networks. A common command can improve coordination, but recognized personnel and their responsibilities must be carried on the public payroll.
sciri_security_state.reference: IRQ_restore_faith_in_army/IRQ_address_army_corruption (05_iraq.txt): 25 land XP/command power and native institutions. SOV_academy: planning/training institution; scaled native military modifier package.
sciri_security_state.rationale: Civilian force control supplies real finite command instruction and a regular personnel establishment; no militia spawns.

sciri_southern_reconstruction.description: Southern Iraq needs useful employment and functioning workshops as well as a new political leadership. A civilian plant around Basra can anchor recovery, while better repair services protect the work already invested in the region.
sciri_southern_reconstruction.reference: PER_anti_corrupt_initiative (05_iran.txt): −10% corruption cost/+2.5% population-tax modifier; actual mapped economy fields. Scaled Iraqi institutional adaptation.
sciri_southern_reconstruction.rationale: Keep the paid southern civilian plant, reinforced by actual reconstruction capability.

sciri_religious_education.description: Religious education need not leave students without the technical knowledge public institutions require. Connecting instruction with industrial skills can widen their place in Iraqi society, provided the programme offers professional teaching rather than political approval alone.

sciri_minority_charter.description: The movement must explain how citizens outside its principal constituency will be treated by the state. Dependable guarantees can reduce exceptional policing and outside political leverage, while placing limits on officials who would prefer to govern through communal privilege.
sciri_minority_charter.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
sciri_minority_charter.rationale: Minority guarantees lower exceptional policing and outside leverage without forced assimilation.

sciri_water_services.description: Reliable water services are a foundation of public health and productive life in the south. Improving the infrastructure through which they are administered will support recovery, but political sponsorship cannot replace the practical work of maintaining those services.
sciri_water_services.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
sciri_water_services.rationale: Preserve the explicit southern water-service infrastructure abstraction; medical costs reflect improved delivery, not invented water resources.

sciri_school_access.description: Schools must be open to children whose families cannot secure a place through personal or political connections. Wider access will strengthen literacy, while requiring the government to supply teachers and materials after the initial commitment has been announced.
sciri_school_access.reference: IRQ_ministry_of_education/IRQ_restructure_school_curriculum (05_iraq.txt): real education law and education-cost/research spirit. 1970 adaptation uses education costs/literacy or bounded categories.
sciri_school_access.rationale: School access delivers direct literacy and actual public-education obligations.

sciri_civil_review.description: Civilian ministers need the authority to examine the personnel and obligations of the security establishment. A regular review can reduce exceptional expenditure, while forcing the leadership to explain appointments that have previously rested on political standing alone.
sciri_civil_review.reference: IRQ_restore_faith_in_army/IRQ_address_army_corruption (05_iraq.txt): 25 land XP/command power and native institutions. SOV_academy: planning/training institution; scaled native military modifier package.
sciri_civil_review.rationale: Civilian review rationalizes the security establishment rather than another capped stability payment.

sciri_iraqi_mandate.description: A governing mandate must be carried into a common command and a practical reconstruction programme. Those institutions can make the state more coherent, but their personnel and continuing responsibilities must remain visible in the public budget.
sciri_iraqi_mandate.reference: IRQ_restore_faith_in_army/IRQ_address_army_corruption (05_iraq.txt): 25 land XP/command power and native institutions. SOV_academy: planning/training institution; scaled native military modifier package.
sciri_iraqi_mandate.rationale: Keep the differentiated security/reconstruction governing mandate and its standing personnel cost.

iip_return.description: The Iraqi Islamic Party must rebuild a public organization capable of more than maintaining its own political circles. Competent civilian offices will give its leadership a governing base without assuming that an old title alone settles who should exercise authority.
iip_return.reference: PER_anti_corrupt_initiative (05_iran.txt): −10% corruption cost/+2.5% population-tax modifier; actual mapped economy fields. Scaled Iraqi institutional adaptation.
iip_return.rationale: A restored party organization has a usable civilian base; the vetted historical executive still requires the registry.

iip_parliamentary.description: Parliamentary Islamism would place the party's programme within institutions that can question ministers and supervise public contracts. That settlement can make administration more predictable, while limiting the leadership's freedom to decide policy through its own organization alone.
iip_parliamentary.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
iip_parliamentary.rationale: Parliamentary institutions support public contracts while limiting executive discretion.

iip_directorial.description: A party-directed state would concentrate political initiative and mobilization in a stronger executive. It offers a clear center of action, but sustaining the security arrangements around that authority will require continuing public expenditure.
iip_directorial.reference: IRQ_cooperation_with_army/IRQ_restructured_police (05_iraq.txt/Iraqi.txt): root-out resistance effectiveness and police-cost reform; country effects are not a geographic security guarantee.
iip_directorial.rationale: Party direction offers political initiative and mobilization, with exceptional security expenditure.

iip_law.description: Religious legal commitments must be made usable by businesses and public offices that need consistent procedures. Clearer corporate accounts and project terms can support that work without requiring every commercial question to pass through an informal political patron.
iip_law.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
iip_law.rationale: Commercial legal certainty works through real corporate accounts and project terms.

iip_associations.description: Professional and charitable associations connect the party with people beyond its formal membership. Supporting useful instruction and recorded service income can make those networks productive, while creating public obligations that cannot be met through voluntary effort alone.
iip_associations.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
iip_associations.rationale: Associations deliver professional education and office-sector collection instead of pure ideology defence.

iip_civil_service.description: A conservative cabinet must still provide officials able to carry out ordinary public work. Professional service can make administration more dependable, while reducing the leadership's freedom to distribute posts according to political convenience.
iip_civil_service.reference: PER_anti_corrupt_initiative (05_iran.txt): −10% corruption cost/+2.5% population-tax modifier; actual mapped economy fields. Scaled Iraqi institutional adaptation.
iip_civil_service.rationale: A conservative cabinet creates competent civilian administration without forcing elections or a foreign alignment.

iip_social_market.description: A social market would give private workshops and civilian producers more room to expand. The government can support that growth through clearer conditions for construction, while accepting the tax concessions through which cooperation is secured.
iip_social_market.reference: IRQ_state_sponsored_industries/IRQ_revive_damaged_companies (05_iraq.txt): civilian plant delivery and +15% civilian construction spirit; no paid generic helper copied.
iip_social_market.rationale: The social market concentrates private civilian expansion rather than Dawa's endowment/service economy.

iip_welfare.description: A welfare programme needs organizations able to provide care without consuming their resources in duplicated administration. More dependable delivery can ease the household burden, but it must be supported by public instruction and institutions that survive the enthusiasm of an individual organizer.
iip_welfare.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
iip_welfare.rationale: A welfare emphasis offers efficient real household provision, with funded education obligations instead of the same stability clone.

iip_business_law.description: Small businesses need confidence that permissions and contracts will remain usable after a change of minister. Clearer rules can support civilian construction and investment, although the government will have to carry the revenue cost of the concessions it offers.
iip_business_law.reference: IRQ_state_sponsored_industries/IRQ_revive_damaged_companies (05_iraq.txt): civilian plant delivery and +15% civilian construction spirit; no paid generic helper copied.
iip_business_law.rationale: Small-business law enables actual civilian construction and project delivery with tax concessions; no free firm is spawned.

iip_charity_accounts.description: Charitable funds should be able to show how their income becomes useful care. Recorded obligations and regular supervision can reduce waste in medical and welfare provision, while requiring an administration that beneficiaries can hold responsible.
iip_charity_accounts.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
iip_charity_accounts.rationale: Audited charities reduce real medical/welfare delivery costs instead of only costing bureaucracy.

iip_national_compact.description: A governing party cannot reserve dependable public authority for its own supporters. A citizenship compact can make security more regular and resist outside political leverage, while restricting the informal privileges through which ministers might otherwise secure loyalty.
iip_national_compact.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
iip_national_compact.rationale: A citizenship compact offers institutional resistance to external pressure and regular policing.

iip_education.description: Community education can reach families that existing institutions have served unevenly. Connecting local instruction with professional teachers will widen literacy, while requiring the party to treat learning as a continuing public responsibility rather than a political meeting.
iip_education.reference: IRQ_ministry_of_education/IRQ_restructure_school_curriculum (05_iraq.txt): real education law and education-cost/research spirit. 1970 adaptation uses education costs/literacy or bounded categories.
iip_education.rationale: Community education delivers a paid direct literacy improvement, not another all-purpose research multiplier.

iip_foreign_policy.description: The party's commercial and social associations can support a civilian foreign policy with practical economic aims. Better project terms and more practiced diplomacy will give Baghdad options without making its institutions dependent on a single external patron.
iip_foreign_policy.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
iip_foreign_policy.rationale: A civilian commercial foreign policy has its own finance profile; it is not a global same-ideology opinion trick.

iip_labour_compromise.description: Employers and workers need arrangements that preserve useful skills when production changes. A negotiated compromise can reduce disruption and medical burdens, while restraining immediate demands that would otherwise be imposed without consultation.
iip_labour_compromise.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
iip_labour_compromise.rationale: A negotiated labour compact preserves factory knowledge with less immediate military output.

iip_public_service.description: Public examinations can give capable Iraqis a route into administration beyond personal connections. Better records and civilian expertise will strengthen collection and services, provided political leaders accept the limits that professional appointments place on patronage.
iip_public_service.reference: PER_anti_corrupt_initiative (05_iran.txt): −10% corruption cost/+2.5% population-tax modifier; actual mapped economy fields. Scaled Iraqi institutional adaptation.
iip_public_service.rationale: Service examinations improve formal collection and civil capacity instead of generic political rewards.

iip_arab_offer.description: A civilian partnership with other Arab governments should be built around projects they can understand and choose to join. Iraq can prepare the commercial and technical liaison needed for that cooperation without presuming another country's money, forces or political allegiance.
iip_arab_offer.reference: SOV_back_to_the_west (05_russia.txt): −25% receiving investment duration/cost and domestic trade-offs; only Iraq-owned capability delivered here, foreign treaties remain consent-based.
iip_arab_offer.rationale: Iraqi civil/technical liaison has direct utility; no Arab partner is forced to fund, join or grant access.

iip_medical_welfare.description: Community welfare must support families through ordinary illness and the demands of raising children. More dependable care can strengthen public health and family life, but it requires obligations that neither occasional donations nor political declarations can reliably replace.
iip_medical_welfare.reference: PER_pillar_of_welfare/PER_utilize_workers_house (05_iran.txt): −5% health, −5% welfare, +5% growth/+10% efficiency gain with costs. Actual PER_economy_modifier mappings.
iip_medical_welfare.rationale: Community welfare supports real care and native demographic growth; it is distinct from Dawa's deeper medical cost saving and does not grant free population.

iip_government_mandate.description: The IIP must turn its social and commercial associations into a durable programme of government. A stronger civilian economy and dependable service income will support that mandate, while the treasury continues to carry the concessions made to secure participation.
iip_government_mandate.reference: IRQ_state_sponsored_industries/IRQ_revive_damaged_companies (05_iraq.txt): civilian plant delivery and +15% civilian construction spirit; no paid generic helper copied.
iip_government_mandate.rationale: A durable IIP government has a clear civilian-commercial productive identity and a real tax concession.
